posts.title: My best summer purchase
posts.description: At the beginning of this summer vacation I treated myself on a new lens for my camera. The lens I got was a 50mm, which has a low aperture and a fixed focal length. I wanted to restrain myself and focus more on composition, while also giving me more options with the bokeh effect a low-aperture lens comes with. This lens was truly one of the best purchases I've ever made.

posts.title: CSS is fun
posts.description: CSS is something that web developers often don't really like or understand. It's one of the classic programmer jokes. I just don't think that this is true or should be true. CSS is one of the most awesome web programming languages we have.
